title: RBX15 5.0 Store trailer: Neon Tide
description: 1920x1080 trailer for the Microsoft Store listing, narrated by Este's ElevenLabs voice (ItsJustEste), built from PrintWindow and screen captures of the shipped 5.0.0 app.

scenes.title: 01-intro
scenes.narration: R B X fifteen. Paint your Roblox Classic shirts and pants. Don't just place them.

scenes.title: 02-empty
scenes.narration: Start on the exact Roblox template, five eighty-five by five fifty-nine.

scenes.title: 03-fills
scenes.narration: Paint fills that wrap the body, one gradient across every panel.

scenes.title: 04-art
scenes.narration: Stack your own art in layers.

scenes.title: 05-details
scenes.narration: Collars, cuffs and seams, in one click.

scenes.title: 06-wordart
scenes.narration: Word Art, in fifteen fonts and six styles.

scenes.title: 07-shirt-spin
scenes.narration: Then watch it on a 3D avatar, in real time, while you work.

scenes.title: 08-pants
scenes.narration: Pants use the same tools, so a matching set is easy.

scenes.title: 09-pants-spin
scenes.narration: Neon Tide: a shirt and pants, made start to finish in RBX15.

scenes.title: 10-outro
scenes.narration: Works offline. No account. No ads. R B X fifteen, from six-two-six Labs. Imagine something else.
